article.title: One 80-year-old icon built an empire from nothing — and the other is Donald Trump
article.summary: I had reservations about writing this column because Dolly Parton doesn’t deserve to be in the same piece as Donald Trump, let alone the same sentence.She was famouslynon-political, and I think that’s one thing Americansof all stripesadmired about her. And in her own way,she was vocalabout the rights of the poor, marginalized, LGBTQ+ individuals, and had a sincere philosophy of unbridled acceptance.Then I happened upon numerous social media posts that essentially said that thewrong 80-year-olddied, and if you know, you know.I got to thinking about the comment, and how it sort of forces us to choose which version of the American dream we actually believe in, Dolly’s or Trump’s. article.title: Republican Mayor Sparks Outrage With Dolly Parton Snub
article.summary: The mayor of a small Mississippi town has sparked an uproar by refusing to lower the flag in honor of the late country singer Dolly Parton.Ken Adams, the Republican mayor of Olive Branch, announced his decision in a statement on Facebook after both President Donald Trump and Mississippi Gov. Tate Reevesordered flags to be flown at half-stafffor one week following Parton’s passing last week at age 80.“I believe lowering the American flag to half-staff should mean something very significant,” Adams wrote Friday, arguing that the honor “should be reserved for military heroes, fallen first responders, presidents, major national leaders, or events that have had a tremendous impact on our country.”Read more at The Daily Beast.
